_comment: Each case folds one schematic resistor (design/ldo_3v3in_1v8out.sch, W/L copied
verbatim, never changed) into `segments` equal series segments of the same W.
rbias_n16 is the #246 study's 100 um bank (16 rows of 93.75 um); rbias_n4 is a
4-row alternative included to bound how the end/head correction scales with N;
rfb_n2 covers the res_xhigh_po flavor (R_FB_A/B/C are identical, so one stands
for all three; R_CZ at L=52 um needs no folding at a ~100 um bank width).
sim_segments lists the N values the single-operating-point ngspice comparison
evaluates for that device (model-only, no layout); op_v is the DC voltage
forced across the resistor for that comparison (see README for the choice).
